summary.name: Robin (Feathery)
summary.one_liner: Robin is Feathery's AI assistant that builds, runs, and advances operational workflows from natural-language descriptions, aimed mainly at insurance and wealth management.
use_cases: Automating insurance submission intake (ACORD forms, loss runs)
Extracting structured data from PDFs, emails and spreadsheets
Letting ops teams change workflows without IT tickets
Checking what is pending or missing in a case and deciding next steps
summary.what_it_does: Robin is Feathery's AI assistant for operational workflows. Users describe a workflow in plain language and Robin assembles it, applying stated business rules, or starts from a template. Once running, end users such as advisors, underwriters and ops staff can ask Robin what is pending, what is missing and what to do next, and take actions inside the workflow. Robin reads PDFs, emails and spreadsheets, extracts structured data with confidence scores and human review, pre-fills forms, generates documents and syncs results to downstream systems. IT can review and approve changes before they publish, and the platform keeps audit logs, version history and rollback.
notable: Natural-language workflow creation with IT approval gates before production publish
Document intelligence claiming 98%+ extraction accuracy on loss runs, ACORD submissions and statements
Built on Feathery's workflow platform; lists SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA-compliant infrastructure, role-based permissions and audit logging
caveats: Page does not state pricing; the directory listing tags Feathery as freemium but the page itself gives no plan details
Focus is on insurance and wealth management; applicability to other industries is not described
Accuracy figure (98%+) is a vendor claim on the page and is not independently verified
